tools.name: hailey_get_company
tools.description: Get the company profile in Hailey: departments, locations, teams, titles, legal entities, cost centers and custom fields. Good first call to read the company structure. Hailey API: GET /Company.

tools.name: hailey_list_employees
tools.description: List employees in the company with their employment status, department, location, manager, dates of joining and employment type. The fields returned depend on the rights of the Hailey user behind the token; some tokens also see personal or bank fields. Hailey API: GET /Employees.

tools.name: hailey_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by employeeId, with job data, personal data, compensation, feedback and salary entries the token may read. Pay and personal data appear only when the Hailey user has rights to see them. Hailey API: GET /Employees/{employeeId}.

tools.name: hailey_list_employments
tools.description: List employments (one employee can have several) with start and end dates, status, organizational information and terms. Hailey API: GET /Employments.

tools.name: hailey_list_time_off
tools.description: List time off for the company, optionally filtered by a from and/or to date (yyyy-mm-dd). Shows time-off settings and each employee's time-off entries. Hailey API: GET /TimeOff.

tools.name: hailey_list_reported_time
tools.description: List the time employees reported in Hailey for a date range. Defaults to the current month when no range is given. Hailey API: GET /Time.

tools.name: hailey_list_job_ads
tools.description: List the job ads of the company with title, description, publish dates, location and department. Hailey API: GET /JobAd.
